description: This Java source file defines an immutable class 'ImmutablePipeline' implementing the 'Pipeline' interface. It manages a sequence of stage expressions and executes them using a function expression, providing methods for execution, validation, equality check, and string representation.

classes.name: ImmutablePipeline
classes.description: An immutable implementation of the Pipeline interface, capable of executing a sequence of function expressions on pipeline elements.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the pipeline by reducing the list of stage expressions over the input pipeline element using the specified function expression and expression resolver.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates each stage expression to ensure it is supported by the function expression; throws an exception if any are unsupported.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another ImmutablePipeline based on function expression and stage expressions.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes a hash code based on function expression and stage expressions.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the ImmutablePipeline instance.
